bugs.what: readiness counts a precedent once per reference: a formula reading the same recalculated cell twice (directly twice, or directly and through a range) never becomes ready; it and its dependents stay blank/stale
prefix minus binds tighter than ^ (UNARY_PREC above ^): -2^2 is 4; masked in the parabola example behind recalc-indegree
column number -> letters drops the borrow for multiples of 26 (Z -> AZ, AZ -> BZ, ZZZ -> AAAZ): recalc names and every reference re-rendered by copy or insert/delete are wrong for such columns

old dependency edges are unlinked after the new content is loaded (so the new references are unlinked): replaced formulas keep stale precedents (extra recalcs, early evaluation with stale values, false #CYCLE!); masked: needs a replacement and a later edit reaching the old precedent
